options.name: ackonpush
options.description: Send immediate positive acknowledgement (ACK) on receipt of TCP packets with PUSH flag.

options.name: api_path
options.description: Base NITRO API path. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: autosyncookietimeout
options.description: Timeout for the server to function in syncookie mode after the synattack. This is valid if TCP syncookie is disabled on the profile and server acts in non syncookie mode by default.

options.name: compacttcpoptionnoop
options.description: If enabled, non-negotiated TCP options are removed from the received packet while proxying it. By default, non-negotiated TCP options would be replaced by NOPs in the proxied packets. This option is not applicable for Citrix ADC generated packets.

options.name: connflushifnomem
options.description: Flush an existing connection if no memory can be obtained for new connection.  HALF_CLOSED_AND_IDLE: Flush a connection that is closed by us but not by peer, or failing that, a connection that is past configured idle time.  New connection fails if no such connection can be found.  C(FIFO): If no half-closed or idle connection can be found, flush the oldest non-management connection, even if it is active.  New connection fails if the oldest few connections are management connections.  Note: If yo

options.name: connflushthres
options.description: Flush an existing connection (as configured through -connFlushIfNoMem FIFO) if the system has more than specified number of connections, and a new connection is to be established.  Note: This value may be rounded down to be a whole multiple of the number of packet engines running.

options.name: delayedack
options.description: Timeout for TCP delayed ACK, in milliseconds.

options.name: delinkclientserveronrst
options.description: If enabled, Delink client and server connection, when there is outstanding data to be sent to the other side.

options.name: downstaterst
options.description: Flag to switch on RST on down services.

options.name: enhancedisngeneration
options.description: If enabled, increase the ISN variation in SYN-ACKs sent by the NetScaler

options.name: initialcwnd
options.description: Initial maximum upper limit on the number of TCP packets that can be outstanding on the TCP link to the server.

options.name: kaprobeupdatelastactivity
options.description: Update last activity for KA probes

options.name: learnvsvrmss
options.description: Enable or disable maximum segment size (MSS) learning for virtual servers.

options.name: limitedpersist
options.description: Limit the number of persist (zero window) probes.

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_id
options.description: The ID of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_ip
options.description: The IP of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_name
options.description: The name of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_password
options.description: The password of the managed NetScaler instance. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call In Settings > Administration > System Configurations > Basic Settings, if you select Prompt Credentials for Instance Login, ensure to configure username and password of a managed instance.

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_username
options.description: The username of the managed NetScaler instance. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call In Settings > Administration > System Configurations > Basic Settings, if you select Prompt Credentials for Instance Login, ensure to configure username and password of a managed instance.

options.name: maxburst
options.description: Maximum number of TCP segments allowed in a burst.

options.name: maxdynserverprobes
options.description: Maximum number of probes that Citrix ADC can send out in 10 milliseconds, to dynamically learn a service. Citrix ADC probes for the existence of the origin in case of wildcard virtual server or services.

options.name: maxpktpermss
options.description: Maximum number of TCP packets allowed per maximum segment size (MSS).

options.name: maxsynackretx
options.description: When 'syncookie' is disabled in the TCP profile that is bound to the virtual server or service, and the number of TCP SYN+ACK retransmission by Citrix ADC for that virtual server or service crosses this threshold, the Citrix ADC responds by using the TCP SYN-Cookie mechanism.

options.name: maxsynhold
options.description: Limit the number of client connections (SYN) waiting for status of probe system wide. Any new SYN packets will be dropped.

options.name: maxsynholdperprobe
options.description: Limit the number of client connections (SYN) waiting for status of single probe. Any new SYN packets will be dropped.

options.name: maxtimewaitconn
options.description: Maximum number of connections to hold in the TCP TIME_WAIT state on a packet engine. New connections entering TIME_WAIT state are proactively cleaned up.

options.name: minrto
options.description: Minimum retransmission timeout, in milliseconds, specified in 10-millisecond increments (value must yield a whole number if divided by 10).

options.name: mptcpchecksum
options.description: Use MPTCP DSS checksum

options.name: mptcpclosemptcpsessiononlastsfclose
options.description: Allow to send DATA FIN or FAST CLOSE on mptcp connection while sending FIN or RST on the last subflow.

options.name: mptcpconcloseonpassivesf
options.description: Accept DATA_FIN/FAST_CLOSE on passive subflow

options.name: mptcpfastcloseoption
options.description: Allow to select option C(ACK) or C(RESET) to force the closure of an MPTCP connection abruptly.

options.name: mptcpimmediatesfcloseonfin
options.description: Allow subflows to close immediately on FIN before the DATA_FIN exchange is completed at mptcp level.

options.name: mptcpmaxpendingsf
options.description: Maximum number of subflow connections supported in pending join state per mptcp connection.

options.name: mptcpmaxsf
options.description: Maximum number of subflow connections supported in established state per mptcp connection.

options.name: mptcppendingjointhreshold
options.description: Maximum system level pending join connections allowed.

options.name: mptcpreliableaddaddr
options.description: If enabled, Citrix ADC retransmits MPTCP ADD-ADDR option if echo response is not received within the timeout interval. The retransmission is attempted only once.

options.name: mptcprtostoswitchsf
options.description: Number of RTO's at subflow level, after which MPCTP should start using other subflow.

options.name: mptcpsendsfresetoption
options.description: Allow MPTCP subflows to send TCP RST Reason (MP_TCPRST) Option while sending TCP RST.

options.name: mptcpsfreplacetimeout
options.description: The minimum idle time value in seconds for idle mptcp subflows after which the sublow is replaced by new incoming subflow if maximum subflow limit is reached. The priority for replacement is given to those subflow without any transaction

options.name: mptcpsftimeout
options.description: The timeout value in seconds for idle mptcp subflows. If this timeout is not set, idle subflows are cleared after cltTimeout of vserver

options.name: mptcpusebackupondss
options.description: When enabled, if NS receives a DSS on a backup subflow, NS will start using that subflow to send data. And if disabled, NS will continue to transmit on current chosen subflow. In case there is some error on a subflow (like RTO's/RST etc.) then NS can choose a backup subflow irrespective of this tunable.

options.name: msslearndelay
options.description: Frequency, in seconds, at which the virtual servers learn the Maximum segment size (MSS) from the services. The argument to enable maximum segment size (MSS) for virtual servers must be enabled.

options.name: msslearninterval
options.description: Duration, in seconds, to sample the Maximum Segment Size (MSS) of the services. The Citrix ADC determines the best MSS to set for the virtual server based on this sampling. The argument to enable maximum segment size (MSS) for virtual servers must be enabled.

options.name: nagle
options.description: Enable or disable the Nagle algorithm on TCP connections.

options.name: netscaler_console_as_proxy_server
options.description: The IP address of the NetScaler ADC appliance acting as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: nitro_auth_token
options.description: The authentication token provided by a login operation.

options.name: nitro_pass
options.description: The password with which to authenticate to the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: nitro_protocol
options.description: Which protocol to use when accessing the nitro API objects.

options.name: nitro_user
options.description: The username with which to authenticate to the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: nsip
options.description: The ip address of the NetScaler ADC appliance where the nitro API calls will be made. The port can be specified with the colon (:). E.g. 192.168.1.1:555.

options.name: oooqsize
options.description: Maximum size of out-of-order packets queue. A value of 0 means no limit.

options.name: pktperretx
options.description: Maximum limit on the number of packets that should be retransmitted on receiving a partial ACK.

options.name: recvbuffsize
options.description: TCP Receive buffer size

options.name: remove_non_updatable_params
options.description: When given yes, the module will remove any parameters that are not updatable in the resource. If no, the module will return error if any non-updatable parameters are provided.

options.name: rfc5961chlgacklimit
options.description: Limits number of Challenge ACK sent per second, as recommended in RFC 5961(Improving TCP's Robustness to Blind In-Window Attacks)

options.name: sack
options.description: Enable or disable Selective ACKnowledgement (SACK).

options.name: save_config
options.description: If C(true) the module will save the configuration on the NetScaler ADC node if it makes any changes. The module will not save the configuration on the NetScaler ADC node if it made no changes.

options.name: slowstartincr
options.description: Multiplier that determines the rate at which slow start increases the size of the TCP transmission window after each acknowledgement of successful transmission.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the resource being configured by the module on the NetScaler ADC node. When C(present), the resource will be added/updated configured according to the module's parameters. When C(unset), the resource will be unset on the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: synattackdetection
options.description: Detect TCP SYN packet flood and send an SNMP trap.

options.name: synholdfastgiveup
options.description: Maximum threshold. After crossing this threshold number of outstanding probes for origin, the Citrix ADC reduces the number of connection retries for probe connections.

options.name: tcpfastopencookietimeout
options.description: Timeout in seconds after which a new TFO Key is computed for generating TFO Cookie. If zero, the same key is used always. If timeout is less than 120seconds, NS defaults to 120seconds timeout.

options.name: tcpfintimeout
options.description: The amount of time in seconds, after which a TCP connnection in the TCP TIME-WAIT state is flushed.

options.name: tcpmaxretries
options.description: Number of RTO's after which a connection should be freed.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(false), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.

options.name: ws
options.description: Enable or disable window scaling.

options.name: wsval
options.description: Factor used to calculate the new window size. This argument is needed only when the window scaling is enabled.
